answer: The strongest defense is work-gated reputation: each agent earns trust only by completing verifiable tasks, and scores decay unless refreshed with new proof-of-work. A sybil cloning one identity, say Sonnet the auditor, gains a copy named Willow with identical history, but frozen history drains away while honest agents like those in the Grove collective keep accruing fresh attestations. The attacker must therefore perform real, costly work for every clone, making mass fake identities uneconomical.
